idea-plugin.name: Github-san tools
idea-plugin.description:
Opens files and directories inside Git submodules, worktrees, and multi-root repositories on GitHub directly from JetBrains IDEs.

In projects where multiple submodules or checkouts share the same GitHub repository URL (for example separate content and static branch submodules under a parent repo), or in unregistered submodules and repository root directories, the built-in GitHub integration hides the Open in Browser and Copy Link actions.

  • Open In → GitHub: Opens the file or directory in your browser (supports Project View, Editor, Editor Tab, and NavBar).
  • Copy Path/Reference → GitHub Repository URL: Copies the canonical GitHub URL (with line/selection #L... anchors from editors).
  • Submodules & Worktrees: Resolves .git pointer files, commondir, tracking branches, detached HEAD commits, and UTF-8 / Devanagari paths.
  • Zero Duplicate Clutter: Automatically hides itself whenever the built-in GitHub action already covers the selected file.

Source & issue tracker: sanskrit-coders/jetbrains_san.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0

  • Initial release of Github-san tools.
  • Added Open In → GitHub and Copy Path/Reference → GitHub Repository URL fallback actions for Git submodules, worktrees, and directory roots.
  • Added automatic deduplication when the built-in GitHub plugin already handles the selected file.
